title: Observable Self-Restraint in Repeated Cheap Talk
abstract: arXiv:2610.33390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A long-lived sender repeatedly advises a myopic receiver who observes only the recommendation record. Nonbinding, observable self-restraint, such as a rolling quota on favorable recommendations, makes each favorable recommendation use capacity that could serve future opportunities, inducing selective advice. With two actions, when obedience requires a strictly positive cost of self-restraint, the sender's normalized equilibrium payoff is subject to a ceiling equal to the payoff from the best credible partitional signal minus the expected cost of self-restraint. This bound holds at every discount factor; under an upper-tail condition, rolling quotas approach it as the sender becomes patient. A sufficiently valuable opportunity can also induce an informative violation that ends communication.

translated_title: 重复廉价磋商中可观察的自我约束
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33390v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：一个长期存在的发送者反复向一个短视的接收者提供建议，而该接收者只能观察到建议记录。非约束性的、可观察的自我约束（例如对有利建议设置滚动配额），使得每一次有利建议都会占用原本可能服务于未来机会的容量，从而诱导出有选择性的建议。在两种行动的情形下，当服从要求存在严格为正的自我约束成本时，发送者的标准化均衡收益存在一个上限，该上限等于最佳可信分割信号所带来的收益减去自我约束的期望成本。这一上界在所有贴现因子下均成立；在满足上尾条件时，随着发送者变得足够有耐心，滚动配额可以逼近该上界。一个足够有价值的机会还可能诱发出具有信息量的违反行为，从而终止沟通。
tldr: 该论文提出在重复廉价磋商模型中，发送者可通过可观察的非约束性自我约束（如对有利建议设置滚动配额）实现有选择性的可信建议，并证明其均衡收益存在上界——等于最佳可信分割信号收益减去自我约束的期望成本，且随发送者耐心增强，滚动配额可逼近该上界。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in repeated cheap talk, observable nonbinding self-restraint (e.g., rolling quotas on favorable recommendations) enables selective credible advice, with the sender's equilibrium payoff capped by the best credible partitional signal payoff minus the expected self-restraint cost, a bound that rolling quotas approach as the sender becomes patient.
